(E. Rapaport Strasser). The Lovász conjecture states that a vertex-transitive
connected graph is Hamiltonian. In the special case of Cayley graphs, one can
ask the following. Consider a set A which generates a group G and is symmetric
(x ∈ A implies x−1 ∈ A). Is there a list a1 , a2 , . . . , an of elements of A such that
a1 , a1 a2 , a1 a2 a3 , . . . , a1 a2 · · · an is a complete list of the elements of G? B. Green
